newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN STOCKS EXTEND LOSSES IN 3-DAY-OLD REACTION.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN STOCKS EXTEND LOSSES IN 3-DAY-OLD REACTION.

text.p: ** (1415 GMT) - Indian blue chips end with sharp losses as
